items.heading: Kimchi
details: Key ingredients: napa cabbage, salt, gochugaru chili flakes, garlic, ginger, fish sauce
Salt napa cabbage leaves and let them wilt for a few hours, then rinse.
Mix a paste of gochugaru, garlic, ginger and fish sauce.
Rub the paste thoroughly between the cabbage leaves.
Pack into a jar and let it ferment at room temperature for a few days before refrigerating.

items.heading: Bibimbap
details: Key ingredients: rice, assorted sauteed vegetables, beef, fried egg, gochujang
Cook rice and arrange it in a bowl.
Top with an assortment of separately sauteed vegetables and seasoned beef.
Add a fried egg on top.
Serve with gochujang and mix everything together before eating.

items.heading: Bulgogi
details: Key ingredients: thinly sliced beef, soy sauce, sugar, garlic, sesame oil, pear
Marinate thin beef slices in a mixture of soy sauce, sugar, garlic and grated pear.
Let it marinate for at least an hour for tenderness.
Grill or pan-fry the beef quickly over high heat.
Serve with rice and lettuce wraps.

items.heading: Japchae
details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.
Prepare and cut the main ingredients.
Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.
